caption: The drawing depicts a large, brown pig in mid-leap, facing to the right, with its legs outstretched and its mouth open, showing visible teeth and tongue. The pig has a curled tail, defined musculature, and black-tipped hooves. Over its back is placed a saddle-like drape that is primarily red with green trim and accents. On the drape, there are two ears of corn with yellow kernels and green husks, positioned side by side. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery present. The illustration uses shading and highlights to create a three-dimensional effect on the pig’s body and the details of the draped fabric and corn.
title: Carousel Pig
